notes: Each row represents a unique food item modification code. The numeric DRXMC is used as the concept_code (unique identifier) and the descriptive text DRXMCD becomes the concept_name. No other columns are present, so no synonyms are needed. The domain is set to "Food" to reflect the nature of the items; this is a custom domain for this vocabulary. The vocabulary_id "NHANES_DRXMC" is a new local vocabulary specific to this NHANES lookup file.
harmonization_reasoning: All files describe food modification codes, so the domain "Food" is the most appropriate and consistent choice. The vocabulary "NHANES_DRXMC" is already used in every non‑null specification, making it the natural single vocabulary. For the concept class, "NHANES Food" appears in two of the five files and aligns with the domain, while "Food" is a generic alternative; "NHANES Modification Code" is only used in one file and is less descriptive of the content. Thus "NHANES Food" provides the best harmonized concept class.
domain_id_correction_note: Changed from 'Food' to 'Observation' -- 'Food' is not a real OMOP CDM 5.3 domain (verified against official OHDSI CommonDataModel docs); the LLM's earlier claim that it was a built-in domain was incorrect.
